notes: The organizer May 2024 course plan identifies the main northern training circuit and inner Turn 13 return, with two kinks and the complete southern loop. Exact independent source distance is 2892.7 m compared with the operator rounded 2.88 km. Northern pit-parallel and angular central access shortcuts are excluded. Exact source coordinates are unchanged; historical alignment and direction remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 48 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: 164 physical image-edge positions are projected from the One Kink measurements onto this oppositely directed trace using the same pinned image, with 22 further positions measured for the differing Turn 13 junction and two repeated closure anchors. Intervals and branch openings remain interpolated route-limit estimates, not a continuous edge survey or a complete pavement-area polygon. The pit lane is excluded. Approximately 0.2 m pixels do not establish survey accuracy; banking is unknown and curbs remain illustrative.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.
